params.name: company-tax-id
params.description: The tax ID of the company whose employees should be listed.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor returned from the previous response. Omit to retrieve the first page.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of employees belonging to the specified company, identified by its tax ID. Only companies accessible to the authenticated entity are allowed.

> **ℹ️ Availability.** This endpoint is available to **multi-entity clients** and **channel partners**. Single-entity clients should use `GET /v1/employees` instead.

info.name: List employees for a single entity

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor returned from the previous response. Omit to retrieve the first page.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of all employees belonging to the authenticated single-entity client. Use the `cursor` parameter to paginate through results.
